text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan  Perintah Pencegahan Pengubahan
Wang Haram dan Pencegahan Pembiayaan Keganasa n (Resolusi Majlis
Keselamatan) (Al-Qaida dan Taliban) 2011.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 5 Disember 2011.

Maksud

2. Maksud Perintah ini adalah untuk melaksanakan langkah -langkah yang
diputuskan oleh Majlis Keselamatan Pertubuha n Bangsa -Bangsa Bersatu menurut
perkara 41 Piagam Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu bagi melaksanakan pembekuan aset dan
langkah-langkah yang berkaitan dengannya yang dikenakan oleh Majlis Keselamatan
Pertubuhan Bangsa -Bangsa Bersatu terhadap Al -Qaida, Usama bin Laden dan Ta liban
menurut Resolusi Majlis Keselamatan yang berkaitan.

Tafsiran

4. (1) Dana bagi entiti tersenarai termasuklah dana yang diperoleh atau
terhasil—
(a) daripada harta yang dipunyai atau dikawal secara langsung atau
tidak langsung oleh entiti tersenarai; atau

(b) oleh mana -mana pengusaha yang dipunyai ata u dikawal secara
langsung atau tidak langsung oleh entiti tersenarai,

hendaklah dibekukan tanpa kelengahan.

 (2) Penambahan kepada akaun yang dibekukan menurut perenggan ini bagi
apa-apa pembayaran  kepada entiti tersenar ai hendaklah dibenarkan dengan sya rat
bahawa apa-apa pembayaran itu akan terus tertakluk kepada peruntukan perenggan ini
dibekukan.

 (3) Entiti tersenarai adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual
Pertama.

 (4) Entiti yang dinyahsenaraikan adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam
Jadual Kedua.

 (5) Perintah ini tidak terpakai kepada entiti yang dinyahsenaraikan mulai
tarikh penyahsenaraian itu.

(6) Kementerian Dalam Negeri boleh memberikan notis keput usan Menteri
Dalam Negeri supaya menyenaraikan suatu entiti di bawah perenggan ini kepada mana-
mana orang yang terlibat dalam perniagaan pemegangan, urusan , atau memudahkan
urusan, harta yang disebut dalam subsubperenggan (1)(a).

(7) Notis yang disebut dalam subperenggan (5) akan diberikan sebelum notis
penyenaraian itu disiarkan dalam Warta.

Menjadikan dana tersedia kepada entiti tersenarai

5. (1) Mana-mana orang yang, kecuali di bawah kuasa Menteri Dalam Negeri
sebagaimana yang dinyatakan di bawah subseksyen 66B(10), menjadikan apa-apa dana
tersedia kepada atau bagi faedah suatu ent iti tersenarai atau mana -mana orang yang
bertindak bagi pihak entiti tersenarai melakukan suatu kesalahan dan boleh, apabila
disabitkan, didenda tidak melebihi satu juta ringgit atau dipenjarakan selama tempoh
tidak melebihi satu tahun atau kedua-duanya.

Pembekuan dana

6. (1) Jika pihak berkuasa  kawal selia atau  pengawasan yang berkaitan
mempunyai alasan yang munasabah untuk mengesyaki bahawa orang itu yang olehnya,
baginya atau bagi pihaknya apa-apa dana dipegang itu adalah suatu entiti tersenarai
atau mu ngkin merupakan suatu entiti tersenarai atau seseorang yang bertindak bagi
pihak entiti tersenar ai itu, pihak berkuasa kawal selia atau pengawasan yang berkaitan
boleh melalui notis mengarahkan institusi pelapor supaya membekukan  mana-mana
dana itu kecuali di bawah kuasa Menteri Dalam Negeri yang disebut dalam perenggan 5.

 (2) Notis di bawah subperenggan (1) hendaklah menyatakan—

(a) tempoh arahan itu berkuat kuasa; atau

(b) bahawa arahan itu berkuat kuasa sehingga ia dibatalkan oleh notis
di bawah subperenggan (3).

 (3) Pihak berkuasa kawal selia atau pengawasan yang berkai tan boleh
melalui notis membatalkan suatu arahan di bawah subperenggan (1).

 (4) Tempoh tamat sesuatu arahan menurut subsubperenggan (2) (a) atau
pembatalan sesuatu arahan yang dib uat di bawah subperenggan (3) tidak  menyentuh
pemakaian perenggan 5 Perintah ini berkenaan dengan dana itu.

 (5) Orang yang olehnya, baginya atau bagi pihaknya dana itu dipegang boleh
memohon kepada pihak berkuasa kawal selia atau pengawasan yang berkaita n secara
bertulis supaya arahan itu diketepikan dan pihak berkuasa kawal selia atau pengawasan
yang berkaitan boleh, selepas mempertimbangkan permohonan itu,  mengetepikan
arahan itu.

 (6) Mana-mana orang yang melanggar suatu arahan di bawah subperenggan
(1) melakukan suatu kesalahan dan boleh, apabila disabitkan , didenda tidak melebihi
satu juta ringgit atau dipenjarakan selama tempoh tidak melebihi satu tahun atau
kedua-duanya.

Penyampaian notis

7. (1) Suatu notis di bawah perenggan 6 hendaklah—

(a) diberikan secara bertulis kepada orang yang memegang dana itu
("penerima"); dan

(b) menghendaki orang yang memegang dana itu menghantar suatu
salinan notis itu tanpa kelengahan kepada orang yang bagi mereka
dana itu dipegang, atau yang bagi pihak mereka dana itu dipegang
("pemilik").

 (2) Penerima itu hendaklah dianggap sebagai mematuhi kehendak yang
dinyatakan dalam subperenggan (1 ) jika, tanpa kelengahan, penerima menghantar
suatu salinan notis kepada pemilik itu  di alamat akhir pemilik itu yang diketahuinya
atau, jika  penerima itu  tidak mempunyai alamat  pemilik itu,  penerima itu  membuat

perkiraan bagi suatu salinan notis untuk di serahkan kepada pemilik itu sebaik sahaj a
mendapat peluang.

 (3) Mana-mana penerima yang gagal mematuhi mana -mana kehendak yang
dinyatakan dalam subperenggan (1 ) mel akukan suatu kesalahan dan  boleh, apabila
disabitkan, didenda tidak melebihi satu juta ringgit atau dipenjarakan selama tempoh
tidak melebihi satu tahun atau kedua-duanya.

Kehendak untuk melapor

8. (1) Institusi pelapor henda klah dalam masa tiga puluh  hari selepas
permulaan kuat kuasa Perintah ini atau permulaan kuat kuasa mana -mana pindaan
kepada Jadual Pertama, menent ukan bahawa mereka memiliki atau mengawal  mana-
mana harta yang dipunyai atau dikawal oleh atau bagi pihak man a-mana entiti
tersenarai.

 (2) Institusi pelapor hendaklah melaporkan penentuan di bawah
subperenggan (1) kepada pihak berkuasa kawal selia atau pengawasan yang berkaitan
dalam masa tiga puluh hari selepas penentuan itu dan tiap-tiap enam bulan selepas itu.

 (3) Jika institu si pelapor memiliki  atau mengawal mana-mana harta yang
dipunyai atau dikawal oleh atau bagi pihak mana -mana entiti tersenarai  institusi
pelapor itu hendaklah melaporkan—

(i) bilangan orang, kontrak atau akaun yang terlibat;

(ii) nilai keseluruhan harta yang terlibat;

(iii) cara harta itu menjadi milik institusi pelapor itu; dan

(iv) apa-apa maklumat lain yang berkaitan.

(3) Apa-apa maklumat yang diberikan atau diterima mengikut perenggan ini
hendaklah hanya digunakan bagi maksud yang kepadanya ia diberikan atau diterima.

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING AND ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING ACT 2001

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING AND ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING (SECURITY
COUNCIL RESOLUTIONS) (AL-QAIDA AND TALIBAN) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section s 66C and 66D of the  Anti-Money
Laundering and Anti -Terrorism Financing Act 2001 [ Act 613 ], the Minister  makes
the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti -
Terrorism Financing (Security Council Resolutions) (Al -Qaida and Taliban)
Order 2011.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 5 December 2011.

Purpose
2. The purpose of this Order is to implement measures decided by the Security
Council of the United Nations in pursuance of Article 41 of the Charter of the Unite d
Nations to give  effect to the freezing of assets and measures relating to it  imposed
by the Security Council of the United Nations  against the Al-Qaida, Usama bin Laden
and Taliban pursuant to the relevant Security Council Resolutions.

Interpretation
3. In this Order—

 "funds" include—

(a) financial assets, economic benefits and economic resources of any
kind, including gold coin, gold bullion, cash, cheques, claims on
money, drafts, money orders and other payment instruments;

(b) deposits with financ ial institutions or other entities, balances on
accounts, debts and debt obligations;

(c) securities, futures contracts  and debt instruments including stocks
and shares, certificates representing securities, bonds, notes,
warrants, debentures, debenture stock and derivatives contracts;

(d) interest, dividends or other income on or value accruing from or
generated by assets;

(e) credit, rights of set -off, guarantees, performance bonds or other
financial commitments, letters of credit, bills of lading, bil ls of sale;
and

(f) documents evidencing an interest in funds or financial resources, and
any other instrument of export financing;

 "entity" includes natural persons, legal persons and groups;

 "listed entity" means an entity specified in the 1267 List;

 "delisted entity" means an entiity which is removed from the 1267 List by the
1267 Committee;

  "1267 Committee" means the committee established pursuant to Resolution
1267(1999) of the Security Council of the United Nations;

 "futures contracts" has  the meaning as signed to it  in section 2 of  the Capital
Markets and Services Act 2010 [Act 671];

 "securities" has the meaning as signed to it in section 2 of the Capital Markets
and Services Act 2010;

 "1267 List " means the Consolidated L ist of entities established and
maintained by the 1267 Committee  with respect to Al -Qaida, Usama bin Laden and
Taliban, and other individuals, groups, undertakings and entities associated with
them;

 "economic resources" include—

(a) assets of every kind, whether movabl e or immovable, tangible or
intangible, actual or potential, which are not funds but potentially may
be used to obtain funds, goods or services, including—

(i) land, buildings or other real estates;

(ii) equipment, including computers, computer software s, tools
and machineries;

(iii) office furniture, fittings and fixtures and other items of a fixed
nature;

(iv) vessels, aircrafts and motor vehicles;

(v) inventories of goods;

(vi) works of art, precious stones, jewelleries or gold;

(vii) commodities, including oil, minerals, or timber;

(viii) arms and related materials;

(ix) patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade names, franchises,
goodwill and other forms of intellectual property; and

(x) internet hosting or related services; and

(b) any other assets, whether tangible or intangible, actual or potential.

Implementation of Security Council Resolutions
4. (1) The funds of the listed entit y, including those in the Al -Qaida
organization and the funds derived or generated —

(a)  from property owned or  controlled directly  or indirectly by
the listed entity; or

 (b) by any undertaking owned or controlled directly or indirectly
by the listed entity,

 shall be frozen without delay.

 (2) Any addition to accounts frozen pursuant to this paragraph of any
payment in favour of the listed entity shall be permitted provided that any such
payments continue to be subject to the provisions of this paragraph are frozen.

 (3) The listed entity is as specified in the First Schedule.

 (4) The delisted entity is as specified in the Second Schedule.

 (5) This Order shall not apply to th e delisted entity  from the date of the
delisting.

(6) The Ministry of Home Affairs may give notice of the decision of the
Minister of Home Affairs to list an entity under this paragrap h to any person who is
engaged in the business of holding, dealing in, or facilitating dealing in, the property
referred to in subsubparagraph (1)(a).

(7) The notice referred to in subparagraph (6) may be given before notice
of the listing is published in  the Gazette.

Making funds available to the listed entity
5. Any person who, except under the authority of the Minister of Home Affairs
as specified under subsection 66B(10) , makes any funds available to or for the
benefit of the listed entity commits an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a
fine not exceeding one million ringgit or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding
one year or to both.

Freezing of funds
6. (1) Where the relevant regulatory or supervisory authority has
reasonable grounds to suspect that a person by, for or on behalf of whom any funds
are held, is a listed entity or may be a listed entity or a person acting on behalf of a
listed entity, the relevant regulatory or supervisory authority may by notice direct
the reporting in stitution to freeze any such funds  except under the authority of the
Minister of Home Affairs referred to in paragraph 5 of this order.

 (2) A notice under subparagraph (1) shall specify—

(a) the period for which the direction is to have effect; or

(b) that the direction is to have effect until it is revoked by notice
under subparagraph (3).

 (3) The relevant regulatory or supervisory authority  may by notice
revoke the direction made under subparagraph (1).

 (4) The expiry of a direction pursuant to subsubparagraph (2) (a) or
revocation of a direction made under subparagraph (3) shall not affec t the
application of paragraph 5 in respect of the funds.

 (5) The person by, for or on behalf of whom those funds are held may
apply in writing to the relevant regulatory or supervisory authority for the direction
to be set aside  and t he relevant regulatory or supervisory authority may, after
considering the application, set aside the direction.

 (6) Any person who contrave nes the direction under subparagraph (1 )
commits an offence and shall , on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding one
million ringgit or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding one year or to both.

Service of notice
7. (1) A notice under paragraph 6 shall—

(a) be given in writing to the per son holding the funds  ("the
recepient"); and

(b) require the person to send a copy of the notice without delay to
the person whose funds are held , or on whose behalf they are
held ("the owner").

 (2) The recipient shall be treated as complying with the requ irement
specified in subparagraph (1 ) if, without delay, the recepient sends a copy of the
notice to the owner at the last-known address of the owner  or, if the recepient does
not have an address for the owner, the recepient makes arrangements for a copy of
the notice to be served to the owner at the first available opportunity.

 (3) Any recepient who fails to comply with any requirement as  is
specified in subparagraph (1 ) commits an offence and shall , on conviction, be liable
to a fine not exceeding one million ringgit or to imprisonment for a term not
exceeding one year or to both.

Reporting requirements
8. (1) The reporting institution  shall, within thirty days of the coming into
operation of this Order or any amendment to the First Schedule, determine that the
reporting institution is in possession or control of the property owned or controlled
by or on behalf of the listed entity.

 (2) The reporting institution shall report the determination  under
subparagraph (1) to the relevant regulatory or superv isory authority within thirty
days after the determination and thereafter for every six months interval.

 (3) If the reporting institution is in possession or control of the property
owned or controlled by or on behalf of the listed entity , the reporting institution
shall report—

 (a) the number of persons, contracts or accounts involved;

 (b) the total value of the property involved;

 (c) the manner by which the property came to be in the possession
of the reporting institution; and

 (d) such other particulars as may be relevant.

(4) Any information provided or received in accordance with this
paragraph shall be used only for the purposes for which it was provided or received.
